title: Chapter 157 The Strong Man In The Cell
content:
Chapter 157 The Strong Man In The Cell

Mr. Zhou pondered for a moment and said slowly: "This method is indeed good. Those strong people are currently imprisoned in the Divine Dynasty Divine Prison. Some of them are very strong, so strong that His Majesty took action himself before he was locked up."

"It's just that it may be a bit difficult to get them to work."

Hearing this, Lu Xue waved her hand.

"Old Zhou, take me to the divine prison directly, just leave the rest to me."

Immediately, the two of them headed towards the direction of the Divine Prison, leaving Qin Teng alone standing in the wind and in a mess.

After a moment.

A few people came to the Divine Prison.

The guards here are very loose, even giving people the illusion that there is no imprisonment here.

"I have met His Highness the Princess, Lord Zhou."

The guard of the God Prison quickly saluted respectfully.

The two nodded and then went straight into the divine prison.

At this time, Ao Qing came to the guard of the Divine Prison, "Hey, do you think I am air?"

Seeing Ao Qing, the guard of the God Prison was stunned and quickly smiled and said, "I have met Lord Ao Qing, Lord Ao Qing, your reputation is here even in this dark and sunny Divine Prison,"

Listening to the praise of the God Prison Prison Guard, Ao Qing immediately showed a look of enjoyment.

"Well~ you are very good. Staying here to guard this broken prison is a bit in a bit."

Hearing this, the guard of the Shenzhuzhu smiled and said, "Mr. Ao Qing has praised me. I have been used to staying here and I have no ambition."

Hearing this, Ao Qing was slightly stunned, and said nothing, and went directly into the Divine Prison.

If the guard of the God Prison wants to leave here and get involved in some official positions, he can naturally help him.

But if the other party doesn't have this idea, he won't force it.

In place, the guard of the Shenzhu Prison looked at Ao Qing's back and shook his head slightly.

This is a strong job, and there is basically no danger here, and he is carefree. He has already made plans to retire here.

It can be said that I have avoided detours for half a lifetime!

And at this time, the Divine Prison.

Ao Qing finally followed Lu Xue and the others.

"Huh? Xiaoqing, what did you do?"

"Uh, nothing, little master, how are you doing?"

Lu Xue withdrew her gaze and pointed to a cell beside her.

In the dim cell, several huge chains tied a middle-aged man in the middle tightly, and the strong sealing power continued to spread.

All of these are the terror of the people who are imprisoned in this cell.

"I think he's good."

"Come!"

The next moment, the prison guard rushed over again.

"Your Highness, what are your instructions?"

Lu Xue pointed to the cell beside her and said, "Open the door, I want to talk to him."

Hearing this, the prison guard did not talk nonsense, and took out the key and opened the prison door.

"Hey, Xiao Lei, wake up, Your Highness the Princess is asking you for a question."

Hearing the prison guard's words, the middle-aged man slowly opened his eyes, and a ray of lightning flashed through his pupils.

"What's the matter?"

At this time, Lu Xue walked to the middle-aged man.

"Do you know the unknown star field?"

Hearing this, the middle-aged man nodded slightly.

"Now, the alien race from the unknown star field has come here. Their purpose is to swallow the entire known star field."

"Want me to take action?"

Lu Xue nodded.

The middle-aged man chuckled, "I know I'm looking for me now if I'm in trouble. What have you been doing long ago? Let me tell you, I'm thunder and I'm practicing the power of lightning, but it's not the temper of those cats and dogs. OK, you treated me like this, now you still want to,

Before he could finish his words, the middle-aged man stopped.

Then he stared at the Lei Yuan crystal in Lu Xue's hand with his eyes.

"You, why do you have it??"

Lu Xue looked speechless, "Stop talking nonsense, is it enough?"

"Enough, enough!"

"Damn it, the damn alien race dares to offend my realm. I must take action to suppress it!"

The middle-aged man changed his expression and suddenly became righteous.

This scene made the corners of the mouths twitch slightly.

Face.

Seeing this, Lu Xue didn't talk much nonsense and said directly: "Unlock it for him."

On the side, the prison guard was a little stunned.

"ah?"

"What, untie it for him, it's okay."

At this time, Zhushou felt a little crying and looked at the middle-aged man in front of him. After hesitating for a long time, Zhushou finally untied the seal.

A click.

A violent aura suddenly surged out of the middle-aged man's body.

"Be careful with your Highness Princess!"

Several people around quickly stood in front of Lu Xue.

However, Lu Xue waved her hand indifferently.

"Everything comes back."

At this time, the middle-aged man stood up and walked towards Lu Xue.

"You are the daughter of the empress of the Divine Dynasty?"

The middle-aged man asked.

Lu Xue nodded.

"No wonder."

"I'll agree first. I won't fight to the death, otherwise I'm afraid I'll be useless."

In this way, Lu Xue successfully recruited the first strong man.

The middle-aged man's strength did not disappoint her. The strength at the peak of the super god realm was even stronger than the Divine Dynasty and several Divine Generals.

Seeing this, Lu Xue threw the Lei Yuanjing directly to the middle-aged man.

"Take it to use first, it's not enough to ask me for it."

Looking at Lei Yuanjing in his hand, the middle-aged man was stunned.

At this moment, he couldn't believe his ears.

Not enough to ask her for it? ?

Looking at Lu Xue again, the middle-aged man suddenly felt that Lu Xue was very kind.

The resentment of being imprisoned for these years was swept away at this moment.

A thousand-mile horse finally meets a good horseman!

Beside Lu Xue, Ao Qing looked at the middle-aged man with a face full of longing, and immediately smiled: "My dear, you are becoming more and more like the master."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned.

"My father, he..."

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Ao Qing hurriedly said: "My dear, the master will probably be back soon."

"Huh? How do you know?"

Lu Xue looked at Ao Qing with a puzzled look.

Ao Qing coughed lightly, raised his head and said: "Intuition."

Hearing this, Lu Xue rolled her eyes immediately.

"If you are wrong, then you don't eat for a year."

"Ah? ? ? "

At this moment, a shrill laugh suddenly sounded in another cell.

"Ahahahaha, Lei Gou, you actually give in so easily."

Hearing this mocking voice, the middle-aged man stopped and looked back in that direction.

"Heh, you are just jealous."

"What did you say!"

A harsh voice came from the cell.

The middle-aged man said expressionlessly: "I said, you are jealous."

"You are talking nonsense!"

"Hehe, then you stay in the cell. When I break through to the God Breaking Realm, I will come back to find you."

"You!!"

Just as the two continued to quarrel, Lu Xue suddenly said: "Okay, stop quarreling!"

I saw Lu Xue slowly walked into the cell where the sound came from.

"Do you want to come out?"

"Yes."

......

The air suddenly became quiet, as if it had solidified.

Everyone was a little stunned.

Why do I feel something is wrong?

Lu Xue was stunned for a long time before she reacted. She actually thought that there was some extreme person in this cell.
